Enter [[the Mausoleum]] and grab a body for [[Mad King Thorn]].

== Quest information ==

=== Objectives ===
* Travel to [[Majesty's Rest]] and enter [[The Mausoleum|the mausoleum]].
* Search the mausoleum for a sarcophagus worthy of a king.
* See The Countess of Hakewood for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 100 [[Trick-or-Treat Bag]]s

== Walkthrough ==

Start from [[Temple of the Ages]] ([[Druid's Overlook]] might be closer, but only allows a party of six); head for [[Majesty's Rest]], where you will be joined by three of the [[Mad King's Guard]]s (a second set of three will join you if you head to the zone's second portal).

Fight or run to the mausoleum. [[Rotscale]] is in his usual position in front of the door; however, you do not need to kill him to enter the mausoleum — instead, click on [[Enter the Mausoleum]], then press accept in the following dialog. You can [[shadowstep]] to the entrance (as if it were an ally, e.g. using [[Return]]). If you are having trouble, send one party member ahead to draw the biggest spikes and then quickly slip behind them. 

The mausoleum itself has no map, but the route is straightforward. Hordes of undead foes are waiting inside, but the Guards will continue to accompany you. [[Pull]] to avoid becoming overwhelmed; if you [[wipe]], you will be resurrected at the entrance. As you fight your way through, open up each [[Elegant Sarcophagus]] (killing the undead that it spawns) until you open the correct Sarcophagus and receive the quest update.

== NPCs ==
In [[Majesty's Rest]]

=== Allies ===
* {{x}} 1 (20) [[Enter the Mausoleum]]

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; The Countess of Hakewood
: ''"Ah, it's you again! The precious artifacts you gathered surely brought us one step closer to allowing our most wise and noble king to remain in the mortal realm year-round. You've proven to be a most useful servant. It's time to complete the next step of the ritual.''

: ''His Highness's soul can't rightly return to the mortal realm without having a body to unite with. Deep in the swamps of [[Kryta]], near the border of the [[Maguuma Jungle]], lies a great mausoleum that houses much of the nobility from generations past. Truly a "who's who" of wealthy dead people! I need you to claim our gracious king's mortal vessel so we may prepare it for his return. Search the mausoleum for the elegant sarcophagus, and you'll have our corpse!''

: ''Oh, one more thing: watch out for [[Rotting Dragon|dragons]]!"''
{{offer dialog
| accept = The thought of the Mad King's soul floating around on the loose frightens me too much to say no.
| decline = Ok, I have to draw the line at corpse stealing.
| ask = That corpse is only getting more rotten by the second. Go to Majesty's Rest and fetch that body!}}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; The Countess of Hakewood
: ''"Ah, yes. I figured picking out the corpse based on the exquisiteness of its casket would provide a vessel of sufficiently noble blood for His Highness's soul. Oh, don't give me that look! We would have Mad King Thorn's actual body, but...well, let's just say the revolting masses got rather creative with it after his untimely demise. I assure you, you would not want to have been tasked with fetching that cadaver! Here's something for your troubles. You may want to wash your hands, by the way."''

== Notes ==
* The area extends far beyond the location of the Sarcophagi, however there are no foes or interactive objects. 
{{Anomaly| The usual quest marker does not appear on the [[User_interface#Compass|compass]], although it does appear on the [[world map]].}}

== Trivia ==
* This quest was introduced in [[Halloween 2010]].
* Prior to [[Halloween 2012]], this quest was preceded by [[Heirlooms of the Mad King]] and followed by [[An Ingenious Plan]].
